title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement: Which of the following numbers is the largest?

solutions.text:
Write each number with four decimal places: \(0.9900,\) \(0.9099,\) \(0.9000,\) \(0.9090,\) \(0.9009.\)

Comparing from the left, \(0.9900\) has the largest hundredths digit, so \(0.99\) is the largest.

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Give every number the same number of decimal places by appending zeros
Compare digit by digit from the left; the hundredths place decides between the leading \(0.9\) numbers
